member.name: T:MixScrims.Contract.IMixScrims
member.summary: MixScrims' shared API surface.
member.remarks:
Call every member on the game thread. Most reads resolve a player through CS2 natives; off the game thread that is an access violation no try/catch can contain, and it takes the server down rather than failing the call. Marshal with Core.Scheduler.NextTick from a Task, an HTTP continuation, a System.Threading.Timer - or a built-in SwiftlyS2 menu click, which Core.MenusAPI already dispatches through Task.Run. A CustomHUD menu click runs inline on the game thread and needs no marshal.
Exempt because they read no native state: , and .
The suppression and flow-control members - , , , , , , and - are plain managed fields and must not be marshalled: a deferred write loses the race against the decision it is meant to change.

member.name: M:MixScrims.Contract.IMixScrims.SetPhaseProgressionHeld(System.Boolean)
member.summary:
Stops MixScrims advancing the match on its own. While held:
A ready check does not leave or , whether the last player readies up or leaves.
The round_end that ends a knife round resolves no winner and never fires. CS2's own round restart is left armed, so the knife round replays until the consumer moves the match on - parking that restart with no MixScrims phase left to release it would freeze the server.
A completed pick ladder seals the rosters and stops there, starting neither a knife round nor the match.
Off by default, and deliberately without a config key: a server running MixScrims with no consumer loaded would never leave warmup.
Clear it in Unload - while held the consumer owns every transition. Releasing does not re-run the decision it blocked, because the ready check is edge-triggered by !ready, !unready and disconnects; drive the next phase explicitly with or . is not a usable nudge - it only adds players who are not already ready.
Safe to call from any thread and must not be marshalled; see the interface remarks.

member.name: M:MixScrims.Contract.IMixScrims.IsPhaseProgressionHeld
member.summary: Current value of the phase-progression hold.

member.name: M:MixScrims.Contract.IMixScrims.SetNextPickingTeam(System.Nullable{SwiftlyS2.Shared.Players.Team})
member.summary:
Overrides the coin toss that decides which captain picks first, for the next team-picking phase only. Pass or to force a pick order, or null to restore the toss. Any other value is rejected as a no-op and logged.
One-shot. Consumed and cleared by the next phase that reaches the toss, so it has to be set again before every phase it should apply to. A phase that aborts before the toss leaves the value pending; cancelling or resetting the match clears it. This covers every entry into the phase, including the ready check that opens picking and the captain disconnect that restarts it.
Safe to call from any thread and must not be marshalled; see the interface remarks.
